item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian forces continued air strikes across Ukraine, killing civilians in Kyiv and other locations, while also targeting Ukrainian data centres to degrade AI capabilities and striking energy facilities, causing multiple deaths and injuries. Ukraine reported a new cruise missile named Filin and said Russian units were infiltrating rear areas near Kupiansk and Khartiia using gas pipelines, while hackers linked to Russia employed a decentralised network in cyberattacks against Ukrainian targets. Kyiv announced a reduction in reliance on Chinese drones despite remaining capability gaps, and Ukraine struck a Russian electronic warfare station. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

The Israeli government also announced a closure of the West Bank following the shooting that wounded five Israelis. These steps expand the scope of Israeli military actions beyond previous raids and farmer attacks. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

item.description:

A drone strike in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73 people, and the TPLF claims to have killed 1,511 Ethiopian soldiers in recent fighting.
